newsitem.title: USA: KCP&L says majority do not want Western bid.
newsitem.headline: KCP&L says majority do not want Western bid.

text.p: Kansas City Power & Light Co said on Monday that the majority of its shareholders do not support a merger with Western Resources.

"All anyone has to do is look at the number of shares tendered to Western to see that a clear majority of KCPL shareholders have not supported a Western/KCPL combination," KCPL chairman Drue Jennings said in a statement.
Western said on Sunday that more than 44 percent of KCPL shares have been tendered and that it has extended its offer deadline to November 15.
